title: Storm Sorceress Over Maelstrom
description: A pale sorceress with long white hair floats above a massive swirling maelstrom in a stormy sea, holding a glowing blue orb staff in one hand while a fiery orange phoenix soars beside her. Below, wooden ships and a pier with running figures are caught in the chaotic waters under a lightning-filled sky with distant glowing towers.
